new.story: An Austrian 2 groschen from 1925. One side is the federal cross with the date, the other a large 2 over the word GROSCHEN. 1925 is the year Austria introduced the schilling, and the groschen was its small change.
new.notes: Phase 1 from both sides of the owner photo. Corrects an earlier wrong call as a Swiss 2 rappen. Austria was not in the issuer list, so this file adds it.
